annotations.title: Quote any token pair (Polygon, Base, Ethereum; aggregator)

description: Quote ANY token pair on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param; symbol from the chain's curated or KyberSwap verified list, or any 0x address) through KyberSwap and LI.FI (same-chain only, compared; best output wins), with Velora (ParaSwap) as automatic fallback. compared[] shows which aggregators answered. Covers Uniswap V3/V4, QuickSwap V3, Aerodrome and 100+ venues. Returns amountOut, USD in/out, usdLossBps, gas, venues and the router. Use for non-BZB pairs such as USDC->WETH; for BZB or BBY use blazar_quote (fee router, trading rewards). Read-only; quotes cached ~8 s.

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn in HUMAN units, not wei: "1.5" = 1.5 POL, "250" = 250 BZB. Set amountIsBaseUnits=true to pass wei/base units instead.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

provider.description: auto (default): KyberSwap and LI.FI compared, best output wins; Velora as fallback. Same-chain swaps only.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.
